rules.name: SYN Flood Attack
rules.description: Detects a high rate of TCP SYN packets from a single source, indicative of a SYN flood.

rules.name: Port Scan Detection
rules.description: Detects when a single source contacts many distinct destination ports in a short window.

rules.name: ICMP Flood
rules.description: Detects an excessive number of ICMP echo requests from a single source.

rules.name: Suspicious DNS Volume
rules.description: Flags a source generating an unusually high volume of DNS queries which may indicate tunneling or C2 activity.

rules.name: Unusually Long DNS Query
rules.description: DNS queries with names longer than 50 characters are often used for data exfiltration or tunneling.

rules.name: Suspicious Port Access
rules.description: Traffic directed at well-known vulnerable or administrative ports (telnet, FTP, SMB, etc.).
